title: The bird on the bus stop sign
logline: The bus stop sign on 101 at the town's edge — where the Greyhound stops, twice a day — and the bird on top of it, the schedule case below, the road empty both ways. Two weeks before the Route North begins.

panels.composition: A bus stop sign on a coastal highway's shoulder with the small rainbow bird perched on top, a schedule in a case below, the road empty in both directions, gray sea beyond.
